display.purpose: The selected entry's name in the fact panel.

headline.purpose: The application name in the title bar.

title.purpose: An entry's name in the index.

label.purpose: Column labels and section headings, uppercase.

mono.purpose: Registered paths, application ids, and every figure.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: the catalogue's proportion bar wiping in when the catalogue arrives, and the margin mark stamping.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The refresh control in the title bar. One control, one action, no fill.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" aria-label="Fetch a fresh catalogue from Discord"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13.25 8a5.25 5.25 0 1 1-1.6-3.78"/><path d="M13.4 1.9v2.6h-2.6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid #232c31; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #9ba5a6; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #667173; color: #e7eae8; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4fc3b0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The catalogue search. A leading icon, one field, no adornment.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; max-width: 420px; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 10px; width: 16px; height: 16px; color: #667173; pointer-events: none; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px 6px 36px; border: 1px solid #232c31; border-radius: 3px; background: #151a1d; color: #e7eae8; font: 400 13px Archivo, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #667173; } .ds-search input:focus { border-color: #667173; outline: none; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4fc3b0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Row
components.description: A scope or platform filter. A mark in the margin, a label, a count.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #9ba5a6; font: 400 12.5px Archivo, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-filter:hover { color: #e7eae8; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #e7eae8; } .ds-filter-mark { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 1px; background: transparent; } .ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-filter-mark { background: #4fc3b0; } .ds-filter-label { flex: 1; } .ds-filter-count { color: #667173; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Index Line
components.description: One catalogue entry. The margin carries the mark; the reference column carries the path.
components.css: .ds-line { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10px 36px minmax(6rem, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #1a2125; background: #0f1214; color: #e7eae8; font: 500 13px Archivo, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-line:hover { background: #151a1d; } .ds-line-mark { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-mark-detected { background: #4fc3b0; } .ds-mark-undetected { border: 1px solid #667173; background: transparent; } .ds-line-art { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 2px; background: #1c2327; } .ds-line-path { color: #667173; font: 400 11px 'Azeret Mono', Consolas, monospace; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-line-os { color: #667173; font: 500 10px Archivo, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Detected Mark
components.description: The margin mark. Filled means Discord registered an executable; hollow means it did not.
components.css: .ds-mark { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-mark-detected { background: #4fc3b0; } .ds-mark-undetected { border: 1px solid #667173; background: transparent; }

components.name: Proportion Bar
components.description: The catalogue's questable share, drawn as one 4px band. Wipes in once, when the catalogue arrives.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 4px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 1px; background: #232c31; } .ds-bar-questable { height: 100%; background: #4fc3b0; transform-origin: left center; animation: ds-wipe 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-wipe { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } }

components.name: Fact Row
components.description: One labelled fact in the selected entry's pass.
components.css: .ds-fact { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #1a2125; } .ds-fact dt { color: #667173; font: 400 11.5px Archivo, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-fact dd { color: #e7eae8; font: 400 12px Archivo, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
This product is a reference instrument, and the system is built like one. A working catalogue is a printed thing: a ground, a margin, a set of rules, a column of facts, and a key that tells you what the marks mean. The app takes that grammar and puts it on a screen where the catalogue is live, where it changes, and where most of it cannot be used at all. The honesty of the page depends on the page looking like it is reporting rather than selling.

That is the whole thesis. A catalogue of ~25,000 games, of which more than half have no registered executable and can never be quested, is a document with a marginal annotation on every line. The mark in the margin says whether the title is detected. The path beside the title says exactly what Discord will match against. The counts on the left say what proportion of the whole is even in play. Nothing is a tile with a rounded corner and a play button; the mechanism is printed in the margin, because the mechanism is the product.

The world is a printed catalogue rendered as ink on a cold ground. The type is a workhorse grotesque with a slightly technical mono for the paths and the figures — a reference typeface and a measurement typeface, the pairing you get on the printed page. Depth is tonal: a hairline separates, a surface lifts, and there are no shadows at all. The single spot colour appears on the mark in the margin, the selected line, and the focus ring, and nowhere else.
keyCharacteristics: A margin that carries meaning, not a gutter that carries whitespace.
Hairlines divide. Boxes and cards do not.
One spot colour, used on at most one thing per line of the index.
Every figure is tabular, because every figure is a measurement.
The page states where its data came from before it states anything about the data.

rules.name: The One Spot Rule
rules.body: The spot colour appears on the margin mark, the selected pointer, the focus ring, and the questable segment of the proportion bar. It appears nowhere else. Its rarity is what makes a detected entry legible at a glance across 25,000 lines.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is made from 1px rules and tonal steps. No card, no panel border, no drop shadow, no coloured accent bar. If something needs to be divided, a rule divides it.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number in the interface is set with tabular figures. Counts, ages, percentages, ids — they are read down a column, and they must line up.

rules.name: The Path Rule
rules.body: A registered path is set in mono and is never truncated in the fact panel. It is the mechanism; truncating it hides the thing that matters.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A raised surface means "this is where the reading is", not "this is above the page". Shadows are decoration, and decoration is not in this system.

dos: Do put the mechanism in the margin. A detected mark and a visible path are the product.
Do state the catalogue's source and age in the title bar, in those words, every time.
Do set every figure in tabular numerals.
Do divide with 1px rules and let tone carry the rest.
Do show real cover art when the catalogue carries it, and fall back to the mark when it does not.
donts: Don't wrap catalogue entries in cards. A 25,000-line index made of cards is unreadable and slow.
Don't use the spot colour for anything that is not detection, selection, or focus.
Don't use colour to imply a state the backend has not confirmed. No green "verified" badge, ever.
Don't use emoji or unicode glyphs as icons. Every icon in this app is drawn SVG on one 16-unit grid at one stroke weight.
Don't add a drop shadow, a glow, or a blurred backdrop. This system is flat.
Don't hard-code a count. Every number is derived from the catalogue in hand.
